translation_direction: pt → vi; direct from 1896 Portuguese facsimile transcription
ai_disclosure: The draft, these notes and preliminary scores were prepared by AI-assisted agents. Multiple AI reads are not independent human certification. No named human translator/editor, reviewer qualification, review approval, open-license permission or reader response is invented.

glossary.draft_rendering: kim khâu / kim ghim / chỉ / cuộn chỉ
glossary.rationale: Keep sewing needle versus headed pin distinct: the head pun and final pin’s advice depend on it. Novello is a ball/wound skein, not a spool requiring a bobbin.

glossary.source_term: toda cheia de si, toda enrolada
glossary.draft_rendering: tự đắc thế, cuộn tròn thế
glossary.rationale: Retain both vanity and the visible wound shape; a clever invented Vietnamese pun would risk changing Machado’s joke.

glossary.source_term: que me der na cabeça / Que cabeça
glossary.draft_rendering: hễ nảy ra trong đầu / Đầu nào
glossary.rationale: Literal đầu keeps the idiom’s sudden material literalization. Translating the first only as thích would destroy the reply’s mechanism.
The imperial procession comparison distinguishes going first from having rank. Lính dẹp đường is a contextual choice, not a claim that the text names a particular military unit.

glossary.source_term: galgos de Diana / para dar a isto uma côr poetica
glossary.draft_rendering: bầy chó săn của Diana / nói thế cho có chút chất thơ
alternatives: chó săn nhanh nhẹn của nữ thần Diana
glossary.rationale: Retain the named classical allusion and the narrator’s mock-poetic interruption; do not silently replace Diana with a generic huntress.
Keeping the author’s four-beat sound is conservative but foreign-looking in Vietnamese; a bilingual editor must judge whether naturalization changes the sewing rhythm.
Read as the seamstress’s bodice, where she parks the needle, rather than the baroness’s skin or the needle’s little body.

alternatives: những người hầu gái da đen
glossary.rationale: Historical specificity is not fully conveyed by the general Vietnamese hầu gái. Michaelis marks the obsolete sense as an enslaved Black domestic woman; Priberam includes servant or enslaved attendant in Brazil/Africa. The story does not separately specify each attendant’s legal status or race; choose wording/annotation with a Brazilian literature reviewer, and do not erase slavery from the editorial account.

glossary.draft_rendering: ông giáo dạy môn u sầu
alternatives: bậc thầy về nỗi u sầu
glossary.rationale: Keep the narrator’s deliberately improbable title instead of turning the speaker into a diagnosed patient or a generic sad man. The literal school-subject formulation may overstate the joke.
Preserve thread as well as the social insult. Do not spell out which careerists the professor means or call this an explicit authorial moral.

decisions.proposal: Use one Vietnamese word for all needles and pins.
decisions.outcome: Rejected; kim khâu versus kim ghim explicitly distinguished at the head joke.
decisions.rationale: Material differences in the fable carry the satire.

decisions.proposal: Modernize the repeated pegou and omit the narrator’s Diana aside.
decisions.outcome: Rejected; retain the chain of actions and the abrupt narrator intrusion.
decisions.rationale: The ironic narrator is part of the work, not an editorial digression.

decisions.proposal: Treat mucamas as an ordinary neutral modern employment label.
decisions.outcome: Not accepted as a full account; provisional hầu gái is accompanied by explicit historical ambiguity and dictionary evidence.
decisions.rationale: A Brazilian bilingual reviewer must decide whether the prose needs nữ tỳ or a note; no silent claim that slavery is absent.

decisions.proposal: Replace professor de melancolia with a natural description of a gloomy teacher.
decisions.outcome: Rejected; provisional ông giáo dạy môn u sầu preserves the comic conceptual title.
decisions.rationale: The cure for strangeness cannot be to erase the author’s strange conceit.

decisions.proposal: kéo chị theo sau, tuân theo mọi việc tôi làm, mọi lời tôi bảo
decisions.outcome: kéo chị theo, còn chị đi sau, làm theo những gì tôi làm, vâng những điều tôi sai bảo
decisions.rationale: The dangling Vietnamese subject could make the needle obey itself; the source explicitly makes the following thread the obedient subject.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source text and aligned translation; exact content hashes attached.
Read the source and target before opening model score records to avoid anchoring.
exit_conditions: Each independent qualified bilingual human reviewer >=9.0 weighted, fidelity >=9.0, other dimensions >=8.0.
All passages reviewed; no unresolved major/critical errors; review digests match the final texts.
Maintainer authenticates qualifications, independence, review evidence, named editorial contribution and affirmative open-license permission.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Hầu gái weakens the Brazilian historical specificity of mucamas. Dictionary evidence and the competing renderings nữ tỳ / hầu gái need a qualified literary historian’s choice or annotation.
Ông giáo dạy môn u sầu preserves the joke but may over-literalize professor de melancolia as a curriculum. Test against bậc thầy về nỗi u sầu without losing the mock-academic voice.
The four plic beats are retained exactly; a Vietnamese read-aloud test is still needed to decide if a local sound-word is preferable.

selection_limit: This is a limited editorial feasibility pilot, not evidence of an absent Vietnamese translation or verified reader demand. The Translation Gap Atlas records evidence and search limitations; no expansion is justified before real reader feedback and reviewer capacity.

additional_adversarial_read.limitation: The additional agent read is correlated AI evidence and does not count as an independent qualified human review. No new approval authority or score increase is inferred.
